source: 分享给其他电脑（仅通用规则）
en: Share with other computers (portable rules only)

source: 完整本机备份（保留所有规则与路径）
en: Full local backup (keep all rules and paths)

source: 显示数量已达上限，请缩小搜索范围。
en: The display limit has been reached. Narrow your search.

source: 此规则包含更多项目，请缩小规则范围以查看。
en: This rule contains more items. Narrow its scope to view them.

source: 白名单配置无法读取，原文件未修改。
en: The whitelist could not be read. The original file is unchanged.

source: 本机路径规则默认不启用。
en: Rules for local paths are disabled by default.

source: 关闭操作已完成，请查看操作记录。
en: The close operation finished. Check the activity log for results.

source: 管理登录、计划任务和服务的启动行为。
en: Manage startup behavior for sign-in, scheduled tasks and services.

source: 将替换当前设置和白名单，并保留备份。
en: Replace current settings and whitelist, keeping a backup.
There are no eligible processes to close.

source: 没有可核实的图形界面入口。
en: No verified graphical interface is available.

source: 没有可加入白名单的可执行文件。
en: No executable files can be added to the whitelist.

source: 强制结束可能丢失未保存的数据。
en: Force closing may lose unsaved data.

source: 请重新运行分享的 Process Keeper.exe，并在系统提示中允许管理员权限。
en: Run the shared Process Keeper.exe again and allow administrator access when Windows asks.
The file or folder does not exist.

source: 重启前需要确认，命令行窗口不代表图形界面已打开。
en: Restarts require confirmation. A console window is not a graphical interface.

source: 当前使用兼容运行环境，部分效果和功能可能与新系统不同。
en: Compatibility environment: some effects and features may differ from newer systems.
